title: FTMM, ATTP and ligas.io launch a strategic partnership to digitalise table tennis in the Republic of Moldova
excerpt: The Table Tennis Federation, ATTP and ligas.io have announced a strategic partnership to digitalise official competitions.
body_html:
The Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova, the National Sports Association ATTP and ligas.io, a Ukrainian developer of digital solutions for sports competitions, have launched a strategic partnership to modernise the way official competitions are managed.

As part of the collaboration, a modern, interactive digital platform has been developed that will bring together the official rankings, complete player statistics, competition results and real-time performance analysis.

The new system delivers a higher level of transparency, efficiency and accessibility, giving players, coaches, referees, clubs and fans quick access to official, up-to-date information.

The project is an important step in the digital transformation of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova and reaffirms the shared commitment of the Federation and ATTP to apply the most modern European standards in running and developing the sport.
